attempts.certificate: 无解。第9列要求放置2个帐篷，而第9列可放帐篷的位置只有(2,9)、(3,9)、(4,9)，因为(1,9)和(5,9)是树；且帐篷不能正交或对角相邻，所以只能选择(2,9)与(4,9)。第8列要求放置1个帐篷，其可选位置为(1,8)、(3,8)、(4,8)、(5,8)（(2,8)是树）。这些位置分别与(2,9)或(4,9)正交/对角相邻，均不合法。因此题目给定约束相互矛盾，不存在解矩阵。

judges.reason: The puzzle is unsatisfiable. Column 9 requires two tents, and its only non-tree cells are (2,9), (3,9), and (4,9). Since tents cannot be orthogonally or diagonally adjacent, the only possible pair is (2,9) and (4,9). Column 8 then requires one tent, but every non-tree candidate—(1,8), (3,8), (4,8), and (5,8)—is orthogonally or diagonally adjacent to one of those forced tents. The supplied canonical matrix is also invalid: for example, (3,3) is not orthogonally adjacent to any tree, and (2,10) and (3,10) are vertically adjacent tents.
